verdict.rationale: Visa's own docs say agent tokens are pass-through payment tokens used at Visa-accepting merchants, authorized through VisaNet with network-level controls. The TAP spec adds that a merchant accepting a payment IOU can expect funds "when settlement occurs." Together these imply agent payments ride the standard card settlement rails, but nothing documents payout, reporting, or reconciliation specifically. Missing for 10: documented settlement/payout flows for agent transactions, merchant reporting or reconciliation exports identifying agent-originated payments, evidence of parity with other channels in reconciliation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
